files_changed.summary: Added createUserClient(accessToken) (request-scoped, publishable key only) and a SupabaseClient type re-export, so the server never imports supabase-js itself (I21/RULE-01).
Unauthorized/Forbidden/NotFound/Validation errors and httpStatusFor/errorMessage — the only vocabulary a route maps (g2).
bearerToken + requestContext: validate the JWT, build the user client, resolve the profile under its own RLS (g4).
4 tests: bearer parsing, missing/malformed/invalid token, profile resolution.
createWorkspace wraps the create_workspace definer RPC; never reimplements the transaction (DB-Q6).
json() and errorResponse() — the route layer's only branch (RULE-22).
requestResult (group-leader rule + run insert), requestMiniConclusion (idempotent read), subscribeRun (SSE events) (g1/g5).
8 tests: scope/owner, leader 403, NotFound, explicit mode, queued, SSE events.
readGroupMinutes — the memory package's real first member.
The complete()/stream() interface 018 fills, taking a profileId and never a key (RULE-24).
POST /api/v1/workspaces — binds, calls createWorkspace, maps the error (g1).
GET /api/v1/runs/:id/stream — SSE, no compression, no buffering (g1).
6 tests: exactly four declared routes exist and no fifth; no route touches a table/RPC (g1/g2, the gate).
7 tests: 403 for a member's group run, 202 for a leader, 400 invalid scope, 201 create, 202 queued, 401 without bearer.

decisions: I21 versus a server client: rather than widening the eslint ignore (which would create a second supabase-js import site), shared/lib/supabase.ts gained createUserClient(accessToken) and a SupabaseClient type re-export, and src/server/** imports only that seam. No secret key exists anywhere (RULE-01).

requestContext bundles JWT validation and profile resolution so a route makes exactly one call before its one service method (RULE-22). It uses db.auth.getUser(token) then the caller's own profile_identities row under RLS; no service-role path.
create-workspace's service has no package in spec §4.2 listed for it, so it lives in src/server/db/rpc.ts (a definer-RPC wrapper is a db concern). A new `workspace/` package was not invented.

The group-leader rule (D-03) lives in requestResult, not the route: the route only validates the scope enum. run.mode falls back to the session's own default_mode column when the request omits one; owner_profile_id is null for a group run and the caller otherwise (spec §5.5).

src/server/llm/service.ts is the interface 018 fills (complete/stream taking a profileId, never a key) and fails loudly (LlmUnavailableError) until then rather than returning empty text; src/server/memory/service.ts is already a real read. No empty placeholder folders.

The SSE route sets Content-Type: text/event-stream, Cache-Control: no-cache, no-transform and Content-Encoding: identity (spec §4.3: no compression on this route); errors after headers are sent become an SSE `error` event, not a status.
